decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Report, 0101, 0110, 0310, 0311, 0312, 0313, 0321, 0322, 0323, 0324 Received: 06 November 2012 
0120 Rev. A, 0121 Received: 09 January 2013 
0320 Rev. A Received: 11 January 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the rear elevation shall be Slim lite double glazing and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with Slim lite double glazing
description: Internal alterations to include addition of ground floor shower room. External alterations to include the replacement of one window with a larger window, installation of a second window both at ground floor level, installation of a new front fence and new gate and replacement of side gate with a new gate (00084/27/P4 & 00084/27/L4)
